# GigMiles

> GigMiles is a net-earnings, mileage, and expense tracker for U.S. gig
> drivers (rideshare, food delivery, grocery, package delivery — cars AND
> e-bikes). It shows what a driver actually keeps after gas, vehicle costs,
> and estimated tax set-aside. Available on the App Store (iPhone) and on
> Google Play (Android); https://gigmiles.app/download routes each device to
> its store.
> The app is FREE FOREVER, no card required. Pro is an
> optional paid upgrade ($9.99/mo or $99.99/yr) with a 10-day free Pro trial,
> also no card.

Key facts (canonical example from the live product):
- A $235 gross 8-hour shift with 105 miles ≈ $175 take-home ($22/hr, 74% keep rate) after $43 vehicle costs (fuel $17 + wear & tear $26) and $17 estimated tax.
- Tax reserve guidance: roughly $0.14 per $1 earned (planning estimate, varies by situation).
- Separate self-employment / federal / state tax estimates, quarterly tracker, expense-gap detection (phone, parking, tolls).
- Vehicle-specific cost math: make, model, year and energy type drive modeled fuel or electricity and wear costs; live regional fuel prices and state tax context.
- E-bike differentiator: IRS-correct expense method for e-bike couriers (electricity per mile, battery and mechanical wear) — the standard mileage rate does not apply to e-bikes.
- Pricing: the app is free forever with no card. Pro is an optional paid tier ($9.99/mo, $99.99/yr) adding auto GPS tracking, month/year views, platform comparison, what-if simulator and CPA export; Pro has a 10-day free trial, no card.
- GigMiles is a tracking and organization tool, not a tax preparer; estimates are for planning only, not tax advice.
